span.font: UNITED SPACE CONFEDERATION ORGANIZATION CHART v4

p.font: This chart combines the hierarchy and TIER structure with the USC Organization Chart. It attempts to demystify the previous org chart, and reintroduces the hierarchy chart that was on a seperate platform. The following describes the functions of each USC entity and the important role you, the citizenship, play in helping the USC achieve its collective goals.

p.span: The Senate. A voting body that deliberates on policies and provides a context for Roleplay, as well as elects a Prime Minister to the Cabinet, who has the responsibility to break ties in Cabinet votes when the situation demands it, and they vote on the Chancellor.

p.font: The Cabinet as a whole is tasked with:

li.font: Strategic leadership of the organization,
Ensuring the safety of the group from metagaming threats, and responsible management of organization resources,
Ensuring the effective performance of tasks necessary to the success of the organization.
Ensuring all members can participate and create at all levels of group gameplay.

p.span: The Chancellor is elected by the Senate every two (2) years to oversee the smooth operation of the Senate and to administer the voting process.

li.span: Coordinate with the Cabinet to identify topics in need of deliberation and voting.
Establish the voting schedule and the means of conducting each vote.

Provide at least one topic monthly for deliberation and discussion. When there is no pressing USC business, this can pull from SC lore and revolve around what our “official” response should be and how that would manifest in-game, if at all.
Assists the Cabinet with the maintenance of USC policy documentation.
Serves as Head Moderator over all communication platforms such as the USC Spectrum forums and Discord.

p.span: The Prime Minister is elected on a six (6) month term. Due to turnover and the campaign nature of their selection, they have no fixed areas of responsibility. Instead, they are expected to work with the rest of the Cabinet to achieve the goals set by the wider group during their election.

li.span: Serves one (1) terms. At Cabinet's discretion, may run again after a six (6) cool down period.

p.font: The Consul of Peace is responsible for the stability and metagaming security of the USC. They also have primary oversight of most of the out-of-game support activities like recruitment, diplomacy, Org social sites, and the media team.

li.font: Retain ownership of the organization and any critical assets. Safeguard access to critical infrastructure like the website, social media accounts, and an in-game org owned assets like the “guild bank” or USC owned ships if that mechanic materializes.
Provide leadership, oversight, and a vision for the Recruitment Team, Diplomacy Team, and Media Team (CBN).

Maintain an awareness of all USC affiliated documentation, sites, content repositories, etc and ensure that they are managed in a way that allows for seamless and thorough handover when leadership positions change. Confirm the handoff for any changes in the leadership position.

li.span: Coordinate with ONI to produce something similar to the “CIA World Factbook” for Star Citizen, with a biannual review of old entries.
Recommend organizations and alliances to the Cabinet to be reached out to for closer relations.
Recommend small family groups and single crews to reach out to bring under the USC umbrella.
Maintain a presence in any groups you are assigned to as the official USC Envoy.

div.style: font-size: 14px;

li.span: Create a top-tier recruitment thread for the RSI Spectrum forums.

ul.li: Keep this thread regularly active so it remains on the first page.
Create a selection of top-tier recruitment posts for rotating in the RSI recruitment chat lobby.
Create one or more high-quality signatures for USC members to use.
Maintain an active presence in the “Becoming a Citizen” chat lobby
Maintain an active presence in the General forum, with a USC signature.
Process new member applications, and ensure they are appropriately tagged in Discord and Spectrum.

div.style: font-size: 14px;

li.span: CBN is the Media Team for the United Space Confederation.
They produce content for our social media sites and to aid in recruitment.
The Editor provides a vision and review and oversight of the following duties.
Create one video a month (for example).
Create graphics to support the website and recruitment threads.
Showcase our activity and achievements.

p.font: The Minister of Commerce responsibilities are to:

span.style: font-size: 14px; background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));

li.span: Monitor USC in-game organizational finances, revenues and expenses

span.style: font-size: 14px; background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));

li.span: Provide a budget recommendation to the Cabinet each quarter, with allocations for each Ministry and the Navy for expenditures.

span.style: font-size: 14px; background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));

li.span: Oversee the USC Central Bank (USCCB)

li.font: Oversee the generation of Trade Convoy and Commodity Trading Missions.
Oversee the transport and shipping of essential USC supplies and equipment.
Oversee Touring and racing missions.
Manage Ship / Vehicle Replacement Program (SVRP)
Operate and manage the USC Central Bank (USCCB).

li.span: Track USC in-game organizational finances, revenues and expenses.

li.font: Manage in-game loans to USC members and external governments.

span.style: font-size: 14px; background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18));

li.span: Operate and manage USC warehouses and maintain accurate inventory of all in-game supplies and equipment.

li.font: Track and manage the loan, transfer or sale of in-game USC supplies / equipment to USC members.

li.span: Manage and operate trade markets out of ships / bases.

li.font: Oversee the generation of Trade Convoy and Commodity Trading Missions.
Coordinate with MES for resell of inventory and/or raw resources on the open market.
Provide trend monitoring and make recommendations for commercial ventures.
Track participation in revenue generation missions.
Oversees the creation of VIP and Economy touring missions.
Organizes racing events/missions and manages the USC's official racing teams.
Manages the transport and shipping of essential USC supplies and equipment.
Track participation in these missions.

p.font: The Minister of Intelligence responsibilities are to:

span.font: Oversee and ensure the generation of Recon Missions.

li.font: Oversee and ensure the generation of Surveying Missions.
Oversee and ensure the generation of Scientific Missions and Exploration Missions.
Track participation in the mission types listed above.
Coordinate with the Office of Diplomatic Support to develop and maintain the USC version of the CIA World Factbook.
Remain up to date with the latest developments in the universe and how those might affect the USC, both immediately and in terms of the “big picture.”

span.font: Oversee and ensure the generation of Recon Missions, covert missions as well as Search and Rescue Missions.
Track participation in the mission types listed above.
Coordinate with the Office of Diplomatic Support to develop and maintain the USC version of the CIA World Factbook.
Oversee and ensure the generation of Surveying Missions.
Oversee and ensure the generation of data running missions.
Track participation in the mission types listed above.

blockquote.font: ACADEMY OF COSMIC RESEARCH AND EXPLORATION

span.font: Oversee and ensure the generation of Scientific and exploration missions.
Track participation in the mission types listed above.

Remain up to date with the latest developments in the universe and provide summaries and potential consequences as a pre-patch release (moving to monthly as development picks up) report to the Minister of Intelligence.

p.font: The Minister of Security responsibilities are to:

li.font: Oversee and ensure the generation of Navy Combat Missions, in coordination with the Consul of War.
Oversee and ensure the generation of Civilian Combat Missions.
If deemed necessary and appropriate, coordinate with the Consul of War on the management of patrol schedules or Fast Response Unit rosters and schedules, or similar.
Facilitate the development and maintenance of threat assessment maps by the Office of Naval Intelligence for use by USC citizens.
Track participation in the mission types listed above.
Oversees the generation of both Naval and Civilian Contractor Flight, Capital Ship Operations as well as related fighter squadrons and small ship tactical operations.
Tracks participation in the Mission types listed above.
If deemed necessary and appropriate, coordinate with the Consul of War on the management of Operational Objectives, patrol schedules or "Fast Response Unit" rosters and schedules or similar.
Oversees the generation of Navy and Civilian Contractor CQB operations on foot, on planetary surface, breach operations, personal security details, mechanized land operations and dropship activities.
Tracks participation in the mission types listed above
If deemed necessary and appropriate, coordinate with the consul of war on the management of patrol schedules or "Fast Response Unit" Rosters and schedules or similar.

Oversees the generation of bounty hunting missions, nonlethal apprehension and "confiscation" missions, suspect investigations, private detective work and investigation of contraband and controlled substances.
Will Track the participation in the mission types listed above.
Manage 3rd party bounty hunting contracts (contracts given to non USC members)
Will ensure that contractual obligations initiated with or between USC Citizen are fulfilled and if needed kept secure and safe.

p.font: The Minister of Engineering responsibilities are to:

li.font: Provide leadership, oversight, and vision to the offices of the ministry
Track operational readiness and maintenance status of all USC owned assets
Provide the cabinet with assessments of operational effectiveness and loadout optimizations

Provide the cabinet with an awareness into changes regarding the USC's support capabilities, including the status of support fleet compositions especially pertaining to: repair, refuel, medical, crafting and outpost construction capabilities
Oversee the generation of Mining and Salvage Missions.
Oversee the generation of Medical Support Missions
Oversee & ensure generation of repair and refueling support mission content. Typically as a supporting role in a larger mission.
Assess USC naval needs for engineering process improvements.
Assess USC naval load-out effectiveness & recommend optimizations to navy leadership.
Oversee & ensure generation of medical support missions.
Oversee & ensure the generation of search and rescue missions.
Ensure the USC is staffed with top notch medical personnel ready for any emergency.
Explore the gameplay options of the assorted medical ships.
Oversee the generation of mining and salvage missions.

span.font: Track participation in the mission types listed above.
Provide advice and support for citizens. considering placing claims on real estate, and track USC citizen-owned areas.
Oversee & ensure generation of base building missions and support.
Advise the USC on the path to being ready to engage in base building and establishing a true USC territorial foothold.
Oversees the activities that provides the USC with crafted and/or improved vehicles, components & equipment.

p.font: The Consul of War is responsible for the effective operation of the USC Navy. The USC Navy is the Star Citizen equivalent of a “progression raid team”.

span.font: The NAVY is not a permanent structure to join, instead it is a mission-focused layer in which assigned Navy Officers (Org Planners) can assemble teams from the relevant Ministries to execute time-limited operations that are vital to the prosperity or defense of the USC within the broader universe.

font.span: These teams are dedicated players who possess the requisite skill and equipment,
and are able to reliably contribute to success in the most difficult content. These groups and member may be considered in some instances to be 'hardcore'.

p.font: The “progression raid team” of the guild. Participation in the USC Navy is necessarily limited to those who have the skills and equipment necessary to complete the missions assigned to them, which will always be striving to push the limits of available content.
Internal structure will be determined at a later date, as the practical requirements for success become clearer.

Those interested in leadership roles within the Navy are encouraged to establish a reputation for consistent in-game leadership presence by encouraging others to log in and fly together, and tackling the newest content as it gets released, with an emphasis on ensuring team success. Lessons learned from these activities will help shape the initial form of the Navy.

li.font: Directors are cross trained as "Navy Operations Planners".
These Department Op planners may be called upon to devise and execute on strategic missions on behalf of the Navy utilizing their respective department's specific skill sets.

span.font: Operations Planning is considered as separate from the department's civilian activities and Mission Planning.

li.font: Training
All Citizens are automatically a member of the Navy, similar to how all Citizens are automatically members of the Senate.

blockquote.span: Thank you for making the USC your place. We look forward to joining you on your next event and feel free to contact a member of the admin team should you ever need anything!

div.span: Blue tags indicate your USC Citizenship status. All members can partake in TIER I events by default.

div.style: text-align: left;
div.font: Members of the Confederation are considered entrepreneurs who are responsible for operating their own fleets and business affairs.

div.style: text-align: left;
div.font: Citizens can choose to participate in any of the three TIERs when they can, how they can.

div.style: text-align: left;
text-align: left;
div.font: TIER II Green Tags: A Citizen who desires to contribute to fulfilling specific departmental tactical goal(s) can partake in TIER II missions.

div.style: text-align: left;

span.style: font-size: 14px; background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));

div.span: The Org relies on member's contributions of time, talent and treasure to help the USC reach it's collective goals via these missions.

div.style: text-align: left;
text-align: left;
div.font: TIER III Red Tags: A Citizen who desires to contribute to the strategic goals of the Org's in-game progression aka Navy.

div.style: text-align: left;
div.font: Tends to be hard-core, dedication to mastery and regiment, such as training, grinding and contributing to a large group effort.
